# Estimate eligibility — preparation, no feature edits

Existing Mote: bd-01M16DBEH9PKER423BZ47ZKBMV. Main CI repair takes priority. Bare-vs-reason API choice is pending owner response; proposal is bare, matching MetricObservation.

Acceptance uses the existing eight-law migration record (20260830T171630.074033Z-p5640-c0000-r0d69-h804190), not a new tracking framework:

1. Observed is eligible+observed; Missing is eligible+unobserved; Ineligible is neither. toOption stays value-only; add total three-way fold and isEligible; map preserves absence.
2. Coverage counts only eligible outcomes. Nonempty all-ineligible support stays Ineligible; an actually empty vector keeps Missing(AllMissing). Invalid policy/weights are checked first. Eligible Missing retains its denominator and missing-value policy.
3. Preserve support geometry: leave ineligible Sample positions in the reducer input, while observed numeric extraction ignores them. Kernel centers use the original declared positions, not a filtered numeric vector.
4. Dedicated canonical ineligible tag, no numeric sidecar row, reject mixed branch objects; existing Observed/Missing wire bytes unchanged. No implicit remapping of historical Missing(Excluded), since coverage-threshold rejection and outside-estimand policy are different meanings.
5. Token policy builders explicitly emit Ineligible for nonlexical targets; update relevant producer definition identities when eligibility semantics change.
6. Benchmark's checked finite MetricObservation remains a distinct API boundary; delegate eligibility/portable conversion without weakening its observed smart-constructor. All-ineligible aggregates stay Ineligible; eligible missing never renormalizes away.
7. Alignment ineligible provider terms are neither imputed nor listed as missing nor included in eligible weighted support. No weighted support leaves a cell unassessable. Reduction receipts count eligible outcomes, preserve distinct wire tag, and retain chart availability versus policy exclusion versus contradiction distinctions.
8. View/report and StoryAtlas consumer text/structure expose Ineligible distinctly from Missing. Compile/test both producer and changed consumer before landing; preserve qualified dependency pin/public fixtures.

Independent semantic consult is in progress. Exact caller sweep, ADR amendment, discriminating regression/mutation courts, reference scope and candidate gates follow green-main restoration and the API choice.

Cold-review refinements: fold's observed handler receives value AND credence; direct WindowReducer doors share the nonempty all-ineligible distinction; zero-weight/nonfinite/outside-kernel outcomes remain undefined/missing. Geometry court positions 0→Ineligible, 2→Observed(0), 4→Observed(10), rectangular bandwidth1 yields0 with original centre2, versus5 if filtering moves it to3. All provider results ineligible remains distinct from all members rejected by contradictions. Retain MetricObservation checked observed construction; do not alias to public Estimate.Observed.

Salvage lookup found no recoverable portable Ineligible implementation. Nearby support/eligibility branches are already landed or address unrelated semantics. StoryAtlas FeatureEdition/AtlasLowering wildcard branches currently classify an added state as observed, so consumer migration and qualification are part of this bead.
